title: Pumping along blocks: a normal form with three ends, a bounded-or-linear dichotomy, and a product test
claim: Lemma S: finitely many states of saturated downward paths, lengths ultimately periodic (threshold T, period Q). Theorem N: a bond of at most c members meeting levels k and k + s moves, keeping its size and the two levels, until every member lies within K(c) blocks of the top region, the lower member's orbit or the bottom band (three ends). Theorem D: per depth tier and residue of s mod Q, L is eventually constant or at least linear. Lemma R: depth pumping. Corollary: 'L <= c at every depth' decidable in principle. Theorem G: if all composites of l0 steps are products, L grows linearly. Computed: the product test holds for exactly the 740 forgetting census patterns (l0 <= r + 1) and fails for the 46 others and the 25 open ones; for the 13 mutants of 8db5da810c00 one carried mode (all-equal orbits down a self-similar type) blocks it; 8db5da810c00-79 has L_12(3,7) = L_12(3,8) = 7 (certified). Referee pending.
failure_conditions: A move of Theorem N that changes the projection onto the bond.
A pattern whose L along a depth tier and residue grows but sublinearly.
A pattern passing the product test whose reach stays bounded.
remaining_obligations: Whether the 13 mutants of 8db5da810c00 grow: open (the carried mode blocks the product test).
Whether the bottom band can be dropped (C* with two ends): open.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law; addressed patterns placed by automaton maps, knots within a level or between adjacent levels.
